chapter: Trumpet teachers and St. Louis heroes
title: Different teachers, different embouchure systems
summary: Thomas explains that the trumpeters taught different approaches to mouth formation, and Langford and Olivieri let a student find what felt comfortable.

story.theme_name: The reed and horn player's craft: clarinet, sax, tone
story.community_name: Lips, teeth and breath: the physical craft of brass playing
